Coquitlam mobile homes for sale: manufactured homes in parks and on land. In a park you buy the home and lease the pad, so ask about pad rent and the park’s rules before you offer.
Coquitlam manufactured homes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

9 manufactured homes sold in Coquitlam with a median price of $210,000 (the middle half sold between $166,000 and $288,800), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 91.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median year built of 1985.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Coquitlam houses listed went from 444 in June to 425 in September, a fall of 4.3%.
Licensed child care facilities in Coquitlam

241 licensed child care facilities are located in the City of Coquitlam: 147 in BC Ministry of Education and Child Care — Child Care Map (licensed; Licensed Group), 94 in BC Ministry of Education and Child Care — Child Care Map (licensed; Licensed Family). This lists where a school building is, from the BC Data Catalogue and the other official sources read on November 1, 2026. It is not a catchment list: which school serves a home is set by address, so check the exact address with the school district.
The child care list is long, so it is not repeated here; ask Jared for the facilities near an address.

faq.q: What did mobile homes in Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 9 manufactured homes sold in Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $210,000.

faq.q: How long do mobile homes take to sell in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 91.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most mobile homes in Coquitlam sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 9 manufactured homes that sold in Coquitlam went for between $166,000 and $288,800, around a median of $210,000.

faq.q: Do mobile homes in Coquitlam sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 9 manufactured homes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 91.8% of it.

faq.q: How old are the mobile homes that sold in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median year built was 1985 for the 9 manufactured homes sold in Coquitlam.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam communities sold the most mobile homes?
faq.a: By number sold: Maillardville (8), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many mobile homes are for sale in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the mobile homes in Coquitlam that match what you want.
